basic_details.job_title: TNJFU Farm Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Tamil Nadu Dr. J. Jayalalithaa Fisheries University (TNJFU), Nagapattinam, has invited applications for 2 sanctioned Farm Manager posts at Dr. MGR Fisheries College and Research Institute, Ponneri, in the Women / Destitute Widow turn of the communal rotation. Applications go by post to the Registrar with a Rs.1000 demand draft. They must reach by 5.00 P.M. on 9 December 2026, so this is a deadline for receipt and not for dispatch.

application_fee.details: The fee is Rs.1000/-, paid by a crossed Demand Draft drawn in favour of THE FINANCE OFFICER, TAMIL NADU Dr. J. JAYALALITHAA FISHERIES UNIVERSITY, payable at Nagapattinam.

content_sections.heading: About the University
content_sections.text: Tamil Nadu Dr. J. Jayalalithaa Fisheries University is based at Nagapattinam, with its Vettar River View Campus at Nagapattinam – 611002. The Farm Manager post is at Dr. MGR Fisheries College and Research Institute, Ponneri. The notice is signed by the Registrar and dated 10 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Send the duly filled application, strictly typed in the prescribed proforma, to the address below. The notice does not say where the proforma can be obtained, and it does not name a postal mode. Address: The Registrar, Tamil Nadu Dr. J. Jayalalithaa Fisheries University, Vettar River View Campus, Nagapattinam – 611002, Tamil Nadu, India Write "Application for the post of Farm Manager" on the envelope. The application, application fee and all necessary enclosures must reach the Registrar on or before 09.12.2026, 5.00 P.M. The University will not be responsible for any postal delay. Applications received after the last date will not be considered, and no correspondence will be made about them. Candidates are advised to send applications well in advance to avoid delay in postal transit.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice lists two communal reservation entries for the 2 posts: MBC & DNC – NP (W/DW) and BC (other than BCM) – NP (W/DW). The notice does not print a separate count for each entry. Appointments follow the communal rotation ordered by the Government of Tamil Nadu, and the University will adopt the 200 point communal roster prescribed by the State Government. If suitable and sufficient women candidates are not available in the turn allotted, men candidates can be considered. B.F.Sc. degree (Bachelor of Fisheries Sciences) with Overall Grade Point Average of 3.00/4.00 or 7.00/10.00 or its equivalent is essential. The cut-off date for all qualifications is 31.10.2026. Term 2 of the instructions says the maximum age limit is as per norms of the Tamil Nadu State Government. Relaxation of rules is applicable as per Tamil Nadu Govt. rules. The cut-off date for determining the age limit and all qualifications is 31.10.2026. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail of the post.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is Rs.1000/-, paid by a crossed Demand Draft drawn in favour of THE FINANCE OFFICER, TAMIL NADU Dr. J. JAYALALITHAA FISHERIES UNIVERSITY, payable at Nagapattinam.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly filled-in application form in the prescribed proforma, strictly typed. A copy of the qualification certificate and other supporting certificates, self-attested. Crossed Demand Draft for Rs.1000/-. Relevant proof from the concerned Government officials, for Destitute Widow, Ex-Serviceman and Differently abled candidates. Candidates called for the interview who are already working in State or Central Government or any other organization must produce a No Objection Certificate or the original application duly forwarded by the competent authority. Without it they will not be allowed to attend the interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates will be informed by post about the date, time and place of the written examination, certificate verification and personal interview. The notice does not give the pattern or syllabus of the written examination. Degree / Diploma certificates and any other proof must be brought in original at the time of interview. No TA will be paid for appearing for the interview. No correspondence will be entertained about selection, interview or appointment. The decision of the University is final in the selection process.

faq.question: Q1. How many Farm Manager vacancies are there in TNJFU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 sanctioned Farm Manager posts at Dr. MGR Fisheries College and Research Institute, Ponneri.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for TNJFU Farm Manager?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Registrar on or before 9 December 2026, 5.00 P.M. Applications received after that will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for TNJFU Farm Manager?
faq.answer: A B.F.Sc. degree (Bachelor of Fisheries Sciences) with Overall Grade Point Average of 3.00/4.00 or 7.00/10.00 or its equivalent is essential. The cut-off date for qualifications is 31.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for TNJFU Farm Manager?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years, and the maximum age is shown as no age limit in the table, as on 31.10.2026. The instructions also say the maximum age limit is as per Tamil Nadu State Government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for TNJFU Farm Manager?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.1000/-, paid by a crossed Demand Draft in favour of THE FINANCE OFFICER, TAMIL NADU Dr. J. JAYALALITHAA FISHERIES UNIVERSITY, payable at Nagapattinam. An application without the draft is rejected.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for TNJFU Farm Manager?
faq.answer: Send the typed application in the prescribed proforma, with certificates and the demand draft, to The Registrar, TNJFU, Vettar River View Campus, Nagapattinam – 611002. Write "Application for the post of Farm Manager" on the envelope.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary of TNJFU Farm Manager?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 35,900 – 1,13,500 (Level 13) in the Pay Matrix.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for TNJFU Farm Manager?
faq.answer: The notice mentions a written examination, certificate verification and a personal interview. Eligible candidates will be informed of the date, time and place by post.

faq.question: Q9. Are these Farm Manager posts reserved?
faq.answer: Yes. The rule of reservation applies, and the posts fall in the MBC & DNC – NP (W/DW) and BC (other than BCM) – NP (W/DW) turns of the communal rotation. If suitable women candidates are not available, men candidates can be considered.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for the TNJFU interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA will be paid for appearing for the interview.
